SCO_BAD_ARG: a bad name or size, or a channel of that name already open. SCO_TOO_MANY: the channel or byte quota is full. SCO_FAILED: the OS refused, or an existing mapping of that name is smaller or another user's. New Windows mappings receive a current-user-only DACL; reuse checks ownership and size, not the existing DACL, so access by other accounts is not excluded on reuse.
